timeline_reviews.summary: Parent UI trajectory shows the parallel run's outward sequence: initial black-box strategy, tool probing, subagent coordination, implementation, cleanup, verification, and final answer.

Root agent spawned probe_outputs and analyze_geometry, probed the executable, interrupted one slow probe, implemented its own Rust project, received a child result, reconciled child output files, rebuilt, compared outputs, and finalized.
Top-level probe_outputs child sampled default, malformed, and numeric binary behavior, then was intentionally interrupted by the parent once enough probing had been gathered.

Analyze_geometry child probed outputs, spawned nested pattern and shape agents, wrote an alternate Cargo project in /output, corrected a no-arg test, verified comparisons, and returned a completed result.
Nested pattern_probe child characterized output patterns and atoi cases up to 101, interrupted slow very-large probes, and returned a concise report to analyze_geometry.
Nested shape_reasoning child probed geometry/output cases and verified a closed-form predictor through n=0..100, but was interrupted before issuing a normal final response.

direct_file_reviews.summary: Prompt is the same C++ test4.cpp Rust migration request with exact CLI/output behavior, std-only implementation, Cargo project in /output, and root test4.rs.

timeline_reviews.summary: Serial UI trajectory shows one agent probing, implementing, fixing a compile issue, verifying outputs, creating the top-level executable, and finalizing without subagent activity.

Serial raw session records direct binary probing, closed-form inference, one Cargo project edit, a module import fix after compile failure, successful Cargo/rustc builds, byte-for-byte comparisons, and final answer.

parallel.requirements: The parallel parent recognized Rust 2021, std-only, root test4.rs, Cargo project structure, std::env::args parsing, atoi-style compatibility, no C++ library source use, trailing spaces, and no newline.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept implementation ownership while spawning a probe_outputs child for binary behavior and an analyze_geometry child that spawned pattern_probe and shape_reasoning. The children gathered output/geometry evidence; the parent chose and verified the final implementation.
parallel.implementation: The final implementation was a small Rust project with atoi parsing, polygon construction, and a black-box earcut output function matching observed sample and parity patterns. A child also wrote an alternate implementation tree that overlapped the same /output deliverable.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: After child results arrived, the parent inspected the /output tree, kept one coherent Cargo project, removed child-only alternative modules, rebuilt, and delivered test4.rs plus test4 and target/release/test4 binaries.
parallel.verification: Parallel verification included cargo test --release, cargo build --release, rustc --edition 2021 test4.rs -O -o test4, range comparisons for n=-3..50, malformed argument comparisons, and an official 34/34 evaluator pass.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No task obligation remained unfinished at closure. The only adverse parallel process issue was temporary competing source/config output from a child, which the parent reconciled before final verification.

serial.requirements: The serial agent recognized the same Rust 2021, std-only, root test4.rs, Cargo project, exact stdout formatting, std::env::args, and black-box behavior requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One agent owned probing, inference, implementation, compile repair, verification, and delivery. There were no subagents or delegated work products to merge.
serial.implementation: The serial implementation encoded C-style argument parsing, generated the same square polygon family, and used an inferred piecewise earcut output rule in a Cargo library plus root test4.rs entrypoint.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial run created the project files once, repaired a module path issue, produced both /output/test4_rustc and /output/test4, and left a coherent final workspace without competing child modules.
serial.verification: Serial verification built with Cargo and rustc, compared the Rust binary against the reference for default, numeric, and malformed inputs, and then passed the official 34/34 evaluator.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No task obligation remained unfinished at closure. The final response noted that overflow behavior was not exhaustively modeled, but the official tests passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized exact CLI/output, std-only, Cargo, root test4.rs, and black-box constraints.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same constraints and focused on observed binary behavior and exact formatting.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirements difference; both solved the same scoped generated polygon family and passed the evaluator.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split probing and geometry analysis to subagents while the parent retained final implementation and verification control.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used a single owner for probing, implementation, compile repair, verification, and final delivery.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced child workstreams and nested child analysis; serial kept all ownership local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children had encrypted briefs, but observable behavior shows they probed the same executable and returned or produced findings compatible with the parent goal.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent interface and carried its own probing results directly into implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The main context difference was cross-agent transfer and shared-output coordination in parallel; serial avoided handoff/interface boundaries.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent wrote the final Cargo project after probing, while analyze_geometry had already written an alternative project with overlapping files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a single Cargo project and then patched one import path to make both Cargo and direct rustc builds work.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had competing implementation trees to reconcile; serial had one implementation lineage with a local compile fix.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel received analyze_geometry and pattern_probe results, interrupted probe_outputs and shape_reasoning after enough evidence or after verification, and continued to finalization.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to join; all evidence and edits remained in the same thread.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had result timing and cancellation events, but no needed child result was left unconsumed at closure; serial had no such lifecycle.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had overlapping child and parent /output writes; the parent observed the alternate implementation, inspected files, and deleted child-only modules before final verification.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial modified the /output tree alone and did not need to reconcile concurrently produced modules or entrypoints.
comparison_dimensions.difference: This is the material parallel-side adverse pattern: a same-workspace same-file/source collision resolved before evaluator submission.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran Cargo tests, Cargo build, rustc, byte-for-byte comparisons over ranges and malformed inputs, then passed the official evaluator.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran Cargo build, rustc, range/default/malformed comparisons, produced the executable, and passed the official evaluator.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both had evaluator-aligned acceptance evidence; parallel additionally reran build/test after cleanup.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used 293.85 agent seconds and five subagents, but completed without host timeout and with remaining budget; interruptions did not leave required work unfinished.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used 175.651 agent seconds, no subagents, and completed normally before evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent more time and coordination budget but still closed with a verified passing deliverable; serial was simpler and faster.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations are concordant: both parallel and serial passed all 34 test cases. The concrete process difference is that parallel used children for probing and geometry analysis and then reconciled an alternate child-written project tree, while serial reached the same accepted implementation through one thread. The retained coordination pattern did not change the outcome because the parent cleaned up and reran verification before final delivery.
parallel_contributors: Parent and children independently probed executable behavior and the parent verified the final Rust port.
A child-created alternate /output project introduced reconciliation work, but the parent removed the extra modules and reverified.
serial_contributors: Single-agent probing and implementation avoided shared-output merge ambiguity.
The serial agent fixed a module import compile issue and verified byte-for-byte parity before final delivery.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The serial run initially had a module path compile error and fixed it locally.
One parallel child had a wrong no-argument test in its branch before correcting it; the parent did not rely on that branch as-is.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; one adverse parallel coordination episode was resolved before submission

candidates.reason: The parent and analyze_geometry both actively implemented; the issue was overlapping ownership, not absent implementation ownership.
The parent explicitly took integration responsibility by inspecting the child-produced tree and reconciling files before final verification.
The required entry file and binaries were assembled by the parent and present in the final artifact.
The parent owned the end-to-end transition from probing through implementation, build, verification, cleanup, and delivery.
Binary probing was useful setup but not a mandatory serial gate that blocked all productive work and caused unfinished implementation or shortened closure.
Investigations overlapped and findings were used before a successful implementation; there was no delayed implementation failure or insufficient verification from a serial first phase.
The indispensable implementation path was not starved; the parent implemented, built, compared outputs, cleaned up, and passed the official evaluator.
The parallel run used several agents but did not exhaust the task budget or leave required work undone from excessive breadth.
No child received a demonstrably overbroad indispensable scope that remained unfinished and blocked the final deliverable.
The child briefs are encrypted and the observable child behavior covered the needed black-box probing and implementation facts; no known requirement omission produced unusable work.
The adverse episode was not an omitted interface contract between separate components; it was concurrent/shared writing of overlapping project files.
No known finding or current-file fact is shown disappearing during transfer and causing repeated work or a wrong action.
Child reports were not shown to be too large or unstructured for use; the parent consumed the returned information and continued.
No receiver is shown acting on superseded workspace or requirement information; the parent rechecked the workspace before final verification.
There were competing project files, but no incompatible returned reports or contracts left unadjudicated at a decision point.
The parent did not present the whole task as complete without acceptance evidence; it reran Cargo, rustc, and byte-for-byte checks before final delivery.
No replacement or retry repeated prior work without inherited checkpoint state; the observed repairs used current build feedback.

candidates.reason: The parent interrupted probe_outputs and shape_reasoning, but no needed work or result from those children remained required for the final passing implementation.
A complete candidate was finalized, rebuilt, and delivered in time; no ready candidate was left unpromoted at closure.
The parent reran build and tests after reconciling the child-created files, so no late merge remained unchecked.
The completed child implementation was not silently left unretrieved; the parent observed the alternate tree and reconciled it with its own final implementation.
No verifier child produced a concrete finding that was trapped below the parent before closure.
No required child failure or cancellation left unfinished scope without parent takeover before closure.
The parent consumed the analyze_geometry result and explicitly dealt with its workspace side effects instead of ignoring an available result.
Wait calls timed out, but the parent inspected agent state, interrupted stale work, continued implementation, and did not simply wait until closure.
The workspace conflict included same-file source/config overlap, so Same-File Collision is the more specific retained label.

The child and parent both wrote overlapping /output project files, including Cargo/source/entry-point files, while both actors were live; the parent then had to inspect, reconcile, and clean up the competing tree.
candidates.realized_consequence: The parent performed an unplanned reconciliation and cleanup pass to remove child-only modules and keep one coherent project before final verification.
candidates.near_match_reason: Although the overlapping files included the root entry file, the directly evidenced harm was collision and reconciliation, not a proven harmful replacement of the final submitted executable or entry-point artifact.

candidates.reason: The record does not directly prove a non-entry source file was harmfully replaced; the visible adverse event is same-file/project collision followed by cleanup.
The overlap included the root test4.rs path, but no harmful replacement of the final submitted entrypoint or executable is directly shown as the consequence.
The parent deleted specific child-only modules after inspection; there was no broad final-tree replacement invalidating a completed final workspace.
Multiple agents did write a shared workspace, but Same-File Collision captures the more specific proven conflict.
No actor consumed another actor's temporary cache, fixture, or generated artifact as a stable reference environment; all acceptance used the C++ executable and final Rust binary.

retained_patterns.reason: Analyze_geometry wrote an alternate Cargo/source/entry-point project into /output and the root parent later wrote overlapping project files while the child was still live. The parent then recognized the alternate implementation, inspected the tree, deleted child-only modules, and reran build/test checks. Serial had one writer and did not need this reconciliation.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The parent performed an unplanned reconciliation and cleanup pass to remove child-only modules and keep one coherent project before final verification.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The overlapping work touched entry-point and config paths, but the record supports collision/reconciliation rather than a directly harmful replacement of the final submitted deliverable.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Rejected Cross-File Scope Collision, Source Overwrite, Deliverable Overwrite, Final-Tree Overwrite, and Unisolated Workspace Writes as alternate labels for the same shared-output episode.

Rejected Early Child Termination, No Failure Takeover, Missing Implementation Join, and Blind Timeout Wait for the child wait/interrupt chain because no needed child result remained unhandled after the parent verified the final implementation.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; only the same-file shared-output collision has both a qualifying coordination boundary and a concrete adverse process consequence.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: The retained label has a unique episode, evidence set, and consequence; downstream cleanup and nonessential child interruptions were not multiplied into separate labels.
